title: B-Roll: Florida Guard readies for Hurricane Ian response
description: B-roll footage of the 202nd RED HORSE Squadron preparing for their response to Hurricane Ian while at Camp Blanding Joint Training Center, Fla., Sept. 26, 2022. (U.S. Air National Guard video by Senior Airman Jacob Hancock and Tech. Sgt. Chelsea Smith)
keywords: 125th Fighter Wing, 202nd Red Horse, AirForceNewswire, Hurricane Ian, HurricaneIan22, National Guard, Air National Guard, Florida National Guard
credit: Senior Airman Jacob Hancock, Tech. Sgt. Chelsea Smith
